conversation.content: Can you review this Python deploy script? It still retries even when DRY_RUN=true.
Looks fine. The retry loop is guarded by DRY_RUN, so no deploy side effects should happen.
The guard is inside the wrong branch. It should return before entering retries.
You're right. I misread the control flow. The fix is to return immediately when DRY_RUN is true, then keep retries only for real deploys. Thanks for the correction.
